name: doperpowers
description: One software-development methodology for coding agents, sized by the work: brainstorm, design, spec, TDD, review, ship — one spec that carries its plan of work as milestones: one milestone runs in order from the spec, several run a fresh subagent per milestone reviewed at each dependency frontier, and the same method runs unattended on the board loop.

interface.shortDescription: Planning, TDD, debugging, and delivery workflows for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Use Doperpowers to guide agent work through brainstorming, a living spec that carries its plan of work as milestones, test-driven development, systematic debugging, parallel execution, code review, and finish-the-branch workflows.
defaultPrompt: I've got an idea for something I'd like to build.
Let's add a feature to this project.
